EXL to acquire AI data firm iMerit for $310 million

EXLService Holdings has announced its intention to acquire iMerit, a company specializing in AI data services, for $310 million. This acquisition is driven by the growing enterprise demand for AI projects moving from experimentation to large-scale deployment. The deal highlights the increasing need for high-quality data, model training, and evaluation services in the AI sector.
